message: I remember the time we had a sudden blackout during a big storm. My phone was at 5% as I was trying to figure out what to do next. I scrambled for my portable charger but it turned out I hadn’t plugged it in. Lesson learned: keeping a power bank charged is just as important as having a flashlight handy. Now, I make it a habit to check my tech before any weather alerts. What’s your go-to for staying powered up when the lights go out?
